title: Victoria High School

terrainReference.basis: Unmodified Terrarium terrain at the center of the school footprint.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap school building and school site
mapIdentity.scope: OpenStreetMap way 161916689 defines the complete current 43-point exterior at 1260 Grant Street. The long south frontage fixes the building axis. The enclosing school grounds have a separate map identity.

note: The original Victoria Daily Times illustration and 1914 school account show the four-story brick and terracotta school, raised granite base, Ionic south portico, strong cornice and three rear wings. The district and architects describe the successive additions, window restoration and two new circulation towers. The modeled top of the raised ground floor is 3.24 m above the reference datum. Main, middle, and north eaves are approximate.
